annotations.title: Estimate the price of one sponsored post

description: Advisory price range for one sponsored post on a YouTube, X or Instagram channel, from its reach and niche, using GlobalWay’s per-1,000 rates. "brand_pays" includes the platform fee; "creator_receives" is the creator’s share. An estimate, not a quote. For a real channel, the free estimator at the returned URL reads its public stats.

avg_views.description: YouTube: average views per recent video. X: average impressions per post. Not used for Instagram.

followers.description: Instagram: follower count (required). X: used only if avg_views is missing.

niche.description: IAB category id from list_niches, e.g. "IAB-9". Omit for the platform average.
